hook: One theme park ride left a 42-year-old rider dead and forced an immediate emergency upgrade.

sections.voiceover: In October 2026, rider Hassan Kariem fell to his death from the Goliath hyper coaster at Six Flags Over Georgia. What safety feature was missing?
sections.visual_cue: Rendered diagram of roller coaster lap bar restraints without seatbelts.
b_roll: Q4 Investor Relations Six Flags document archive view

sections.voiceover: Except Six Flags' CEO announced seatbelts'll be added across rides with similar restraints.
sections.visual_cue: Close up shot of a safety seatbelt buckle being fastened.

sections.voiceover: Six Flags CEO John Reilly confirmed those urgent modifications in an October 23, 2026 letter. AP News reported the operator decided to install safety seatbelts across other company rides.

sections.voiceover: Six Flags added seatbelts to the Goliath roller coaster.
